description: Aggregate federal caseload statistics from the Federal Judicial Center's Integrated Database (FJC IDB), case counts by nature of suit (civil/appellate), offense code (criminal), disposition, fiscal year and district/circuit. Returns the TOTAL count first, then a breakdown grouped by whichever dimensions you ask for. Requires fiscal_year AND/OR district_or_circuit (a code or a court name such as "Eastern District of Texas"; an unfiltered query across every year and district cannot be answered accurately). Use this for "how many X cases were filed/terminated in district Y in year Z" questions, for a single case's outcome use fjc_case_outcome_lookup instead. Periodic snapshot, refreshed on a schedule, the response carries `data_as_of`. Keyless.

case_type.description: Which FJC IDB dataset to aggregate.

district_or_circuit.description: District court (civil/criminal) or circuit (appellate): the FJC numeric code ("40") or a name or abbreviation ("Eastern District of Texas", "E.D. Tex.", "txed", "Fifth Circuit"). The response echoes the resolved code and name. Required if fiscal_year is omitted.

fiscal_year.description: Restrict to one FJC fiscal year (October-September; pre-1992 is July-June, see the pack README). Required if district_or_circuit is omitted.

group_by.description: Dimensions to break the total down by (default: nature_of_suit_code for civil/appellate, offense_code for criminal).

offense_code.description: Criminal only: FJC lead-offense code at filing.

name: fjc_case_outcomes_summary
title: Fjc Case Outcomes Summary
